system.description:
You target a creature and amplify their nervous system, enhancing all instances of pain to a massive degree. Select a target creature you can see within range. For the duration, once per turn, whenever you deal damage using an attack, you deal an additional 1d6 Psychic damage.

If the triggering attack was a Genjutsu, this bonus damage effect can trigger up to twice per turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and select one additional creature to be affected. If cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the damage bonus to 2d6. If cast at S-Rank, increase the damage bonus to 3d6.
